name: Shelly Headen

items.text: In September 2026, older social media posts under Headen's name resurfaced. They included wishing for an attack on US soil in Alabama and Louisiana and "Ready for the MAGAs to die off!!" The House Democratic Caucus and Guilford County Democrats withdrew support. Headen said she recalled writing anti-Trump posts but not their wording, and didn't remember the Alabama comment.
items.why: These are condemned statements, not a finding of abuse of office, and WRAL could not independently confirm she wrote the posts, so they have no clear bearing on a criterion (commitment to the country at most) and are shown without counting.

for_review: The owner-site search turned up nothing about Headen. The WFDD article body did not load when opened, so her reported apology rests only on a search snippet and a Ballotpedia summary. It is left out of the text. The caucus attributes the posts to her and she partly acknowledged them, but WRAL could not independently verify authorship, and she denied having the X account. A Breitbart-sourced claim about two 2024 law-enforcement incident reports involving her husband appeared only in a partisan outlet. It was not read or verified and is not an established charge. A reported Dachau post also appeared only in a partisan outlet. Both are worth checking in primary records. Her election win (by 233 votes, unofficial) was reported Nov. 4-5, 2026. No platform or financial records were reviewed in this item.
